agents.label: wave0-contracts
agents.owns: src/openlens/core/interfaces.py, src/openlens/core/context.py, src/openlens/config.py, pyproject.toml dependencies, src/openlens/**/__init__.py (all packages)
agents.task: Recreate .venv with 'uv venv' + 'uv sync' (the checked-in .venv is broken; do not repair it). Declare all runtime dependencies upfront in pyproject.toml: fastapi, uvicorn, pyyaml, httpx, opensearch-py. Then implement core contracts from skeleton plan step 2: Document, SearchRequest, SearchResult, SearchResponse, SearchContext dataclasses; abstract SearchProvider (search, health_check, configure) and SearchPlugin (name, type, stage, config schema, dependencies, mandatory/optional failure); the 10-stage pipeline enum; ProviderError/PluginError taxonomy; Engine public method signatures the API will code against; and the shared config loader in src/openlens/config.py (load_config with ${ENV_VAR} resolution, startup validation error).
agents.done: 'uv run python -c "import openlens.core.interfaces, openlens.core.context, openlens.config"' clean; tests/unit/test_contracts.py proves interfaces are abstract and errors carry metadata.

agents.label: wave1a-retrieval
agents.task: Build the working search core (skeleton plan step 3): SQLite FTS5 document repository, minimal indexer over local seed documents, CustomIndexProvider implementing the SearchProvider interface, query parser, result normalizer, deduplicator. Seed with a small fixture corpus.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_custom_index.py green: index docs, search returns normalized results with original_score, pagination works.

agents.label: wave1b-providers
agents.owns: src/openlens/providers/base.py, manager.py, registry.py, capabilities.py, opensearch.py, external.py (+ one concrete adapter), configs/providers.yaml, tests/unit/test_providers.py
agents.task: Build the provider system (step 4) on the Wave-0 config loader (import it, do not reimplement or edit it): startup validation (only enabled providers instantiate), manager with single-provider strategy, bounded timeouts, health checks. OpenSearch adapter + generic ExternalSearchProvider base + one concrete external adapter, both disabled by default, offline-safe.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_providers.py green using fakes: config toggles, validation rejects bad config, timeouts bounded, disabled providers absent.

agents.label: wave1c-pipeline
agents.owns: src/openlens/core/pipeline.py, core/engine.py, core/registry.py, src/openlens/plugins/ (base, safety filter, trust enricher), src/openlens/ranking/, configs/ranking.yaml, tests/unit/test_pipeline.py
agents.task: Build plugin pipeline + ranking (steps 5-6): deterministic stage runner with dependency/ordering validation, fail-closed mandatory filters vs isolated optional-plugin failures, plugin registry, baseline relevance scorer, one exclusion filter, one trust-warning enricher, explanation assembly (original_score vs final_score, reasons/warnings), per-mode ranking profiles (default, child-safe, news, shopping, travel).
agents.done: tests/unit/test_pipeline.py green: filter excludes, scorer reorders, mandatory-filter outage fails closed, optional-plugin failure isolated.

agents.label: wave1d-api
agents.task: Build the API surface (step 7 minus observability wiring): FastAPI schemas and POST /api/v1/search with validation, pagination, applied-filter reporting, consistent errors. Code against Wave-0 Engine signatures using a fake engine; integration performs real wiring.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_api.py green against the fake engine: validation, pagination, error shape, applied-filter reporting.

agents.label: wave2e-ai
agents.owns: src/openlens/models/, configs/models.yaml, one AI plugin stub under src/openlens/plugins/, tests/unit/test_ai_seams.py
agents.task: Build AI seams (step 8): AIModelProvider interface (complete, embed, classify, configure, health_check) + registry mirroring the search-provider pattern, FakeModelProvider, models.yaml with all backends disabled by default, one AI plugin stub wired through the interface. No live model calls.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_ai_seams.py green: fake backend swaps via config, disabled backends never instantiate, plugin stub runs offline.

agents.label: wave2f-tests
agents.task: Build contract + quality tests (step 9): provider-conformance suite every provider must pass (normalization, pagination, timeout, failure mapping), plugin-conformance suite (stage declaration, fail-closed, isolation), cross-provider dedup test, config-toggle tests, secret-leak test (no keys in responses/logs), repeatable fixture corpus.
agents.done: New suites green against Wave-1 code; failures name the owning agent's files and are reported, not fixed here.

integrate.label: wave3-integrate
integrate.owns: wiring and fixes anywhere (no new features)
integrate.task: Wire the real Engine into main.py and the API, add the fallback strategy (primary + bounded fallback, failure distinguished from empty), provider/plugin latency and execution diagnostics in responses, then run the FULL suite 'uv run pytest tests/unit tests/integration' until green, fixing fallout. Smoke-test: start uvicorn, POST one shopping-mode query, confirm results carry reasons, applied_filters, diagnostics; toggle one provider and one plugin via YAML only and re-run to prove no core edits.
integrate.done: Full suite green, smoke test observed, summary carries the 11-item Definition-of-Done checklist with pass/fail per item and the exact test command evidencing each pass.
